व्यंसक (कः) 1.
m. A cheat, a juggler.

व्यंसनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may be
cheated.

व्यक्त-दृष्टार्थ (र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
m. Perceiv-
ing; understanding; present.

व्यक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Individuality; ap-
pearance; case, inflexion.

व्यग्र (ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
a. Bewildered, dis-
tracted alarmed; eager.

व्यङ्ग (ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
m. A frog; a crip-
ple; dark spots on the face.
a.
Deformed, disfigured.

व्यच् (श) व्यचति 6.
a. To cheat,
deceive.

व्यञ्जक (कः) 1.
m. Mark of passion
or feeling; significant speech;
a symbol, a figure.

व्यञ्जकत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Nature of a figure.

व्य_ञ्जिजिषु (षुः-षुः-षु)
a. Wishing to
manifest or expose.

व्यति-कर (रः-री-रं)
m. Reverse;
calamity, reciprocity, contact.
a.
Reciprocal; contiguous, affect-
ing.

व्यतिरेक (कः) 1.
m. Difference; ex-
clusion; figure of speech.

व्यतिरेकिन् (की-किनी-कि)
a. Except-
ing; distinguishing; different.

व्यतिरेक्युदाहरण (णं) 1.
n. Illustra-
tion by negatives.

व्यतिषङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. Mutual or re-
ciprocal junction or relation.

व्यति-हार (रः) 1.
m. Barter, ex-
change, especially of blows,
abuse &c.

व्यती-पात (तः) 1.
m. portentous ca-
lamity or omen; contempt;
17th astrological
Yoga; new
moon falling on Sunday.

व्यत्यय (यः) 1.
m. Contrariety; re-
verse; retrograde order.

व्यथ् (ङ) व्यथते 1.
d. To fear; be
unhappy; suffer pain.

व्यथनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may or
should be pained.

व्याध (धः) 1.
m. A hunter, deer-kil-
ler; low man.

व्यध्य (ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
m. A butt; mark to
shoot at.
a. That should behit.

व्यप-देष्टृ (ष्टा) 4.
m. One who shews
or deceives; an informer.

व्यपा_श्रित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Fled for re-
fuge; relying upon.

व्यपेक्षा (क्षा) 1.
f. Expectation; mu-
tual relation; use.

व्यपेक्षणीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may
be expected.

व्यपोढ (ढः-ढा-ढं)
a. Borne or dri-
ven away; opposite.

व्यभि-चार (रः) 1.
m. Following im-
proper courses; erring; adultery.

व्यभि-चारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Follow-
[]
ing or doing what is impro-
per; going astray; adulterer.
n.
Whoredom or its effects; wrong
course.

व्यय् व्ययति 1.
a. To go. (क) व्यायति
10.
a. To lessen; to send. (कि)
व्ययते 1.
d. व्यययति 10.
a. To ex-
pend, waste.

व्यय (यः) 1.
m. Expenditure; de-
struction; decline.

व्ययित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Expended, dis-
sipated; declined.

व्यर्थ (र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
a. Useless; unmean-
ing; vain.

व्यलीक (कः-का-कं)
n. Pain, torture;
fault; reverse; cheating.
m. A
catamite.
a. Displeasing; unfit;
improper; painful; strange.

व्यव-छेद (दः) 1.
m. Cutting asunder;
[]
letting fly an arrow; dividing, a
division; distinction.

व्यव-धा (धा) 1.
f. A covering, a
screen; concealment.

व्यव-सित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Energetic;
tricked.
n. Certainty.

व्यव-स्था (स्था) 1.
f. Separating; a
decree, law, engagement.

व्यवस्था_तिक्रम (मः) 1.
m. Breaking
a contract or law.

व्यवस्था-तिवर्त्तिन् (र्त्ती) 5.
m. Who
breaks a contract or law.

व्यव-स्थापन (नं) 1.
n. Laying down
the law; placing, fixing.

व्यवस्थापित (तः-ता-तं)
a. By law
established; determined.

व्यव-हर्त्तव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That should
be done or litigated.

व्यव-हर्त्तृ (र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) 1.
m. A judge;
umpire; plaintiff; partner.
a.
Following business or usages.

व्यवहार-ज्ञ (ज्ञः) 1.
m. A person who
has passed his minority.

व्यवहार-दर्शन (नं) 1.
n. Judicial in-
vestigation, trial.

व्यवहार-पद (दं) 1.
m. A title of juris-
prudence; any act cognizable
in a court of law.

व्यवहार-पाद (दः) 1.
m. A stage in
legal proceedings, either the
plaint, defence, proof or deci-
sion.

व्यवहार-प्राप्त (प्तः) 1.
m. A youth of age.

व्यवहार-मातृका (का) 1.
f. Legal pro-
cedure or process in general.

व्यवहार-मार्ग (र्गः) 1.
m. A title of
jurisprudence; any thing ac-
tionable.

व्यवहार-विषय (यः-यं) 1.
m. n. A title
of jurisprudence; any thing ac-
tionable.

व्यवहारा_योग्य (ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
a. Unfit
to go to law.
m. A minor.

व्यवहारिका (का) 1.
f. Usage, cus-
tom; a broom; a plant,
Ingua.

व्या_वहारिक (कः) 1.
m. A counsellor,
minister.
a. Judicial, customary.

व्यव-हार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
a. To be ob-
served or practised; actionable;
customary.

व्यव-हित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Placed or
situated between or contiguous-
ly; concealed; outdone; per-
formed.

व्यवाय (यः) 1.
m. Copulation; cov-
ering; purity; interval.
n. Light.

व्यवाय-दीन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Debauch-
ed; debased by lust.

व्यवायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
m. A lecher;
an aphrodisiac drug; a stimu-
lant.
a. Lecherous, diffusive.

व्यष्टि (ष्टिः) 3.
f. Individuality pro-
duced by the indwelling of God;
Vedānta.

व्यसन (नं) 1.
n. Calamity; fate; vice;
failure; air; individuality; at-
tachment.

व्यसनिन् (नी-निनी-नि)
a. Addicted
to evil practices; calamitous.

व्यस्त (स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
a. Confounded;
pervaded; inherent in every
part; reversed; opposite; tossed
about; perplexed.

व्यस्त-पद (दं) 1.
n. Perplexed and
indistinct statement.

व्यस्तार (रं) 1.
n. Issue of the fluid
from the forehead of the ele-
phant.

व्यह्न (ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं)
a. Done in two days.

व्याकुल-मनस् (नाः-नाः-नः)
a. Of agi-
tated mind.

व्या_कृति (तिः) 2.
f. Explanation,
translation; change; grammar.

व्या-ख्यात (तः-ता-तं)
a. Spoken, ex-
plained; conquered.

व्या_घ्र (घ्रः) 1.
m. A tiger; a castor-
oil tree.
f. (नी) A prickly night-
shade. (
In comp.) Best.

व्याघ्र-दल (लः) 1.
m. A red variety
of the castor-oil tree.

व्याघ्र-नख (खं-खी) 1.
n. Tiger's claw,
a sort of perfume.
n. A scratch;
a root.

व्याघ्रनखक (कं) 1.
n. A scratch with
the nails.

व्याघ्र-पाद (दः) 1.
m. Flacourtia
sapida; name of a sage.

व्याघ्र-पुच्छ (च्छः) 1.
m. The castor-
oil tree.

व्याज-निन्दा (न्दा) 1.
f. Apparent cen-
sure, but covert praise.

व्याज-स्तुति (तिः) 2.
f. Praise or cen-
sure meaning the opposite of
what is expressed.

व्याजो_क्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Covert expres-
sion concealing the real cause.

व्याड (डः) 1.
m. A snake; beast of
prey;
Indra; a rogue.

व्याडि (डिः) 2.
m. Name of a cele-
brated grammarian.

व्या_न (नः) 1.
m. One of the five
vital airs, diffused throughout
the body.

व्या_पक (कः-का-कं)
a. Diffusive.
n.
Essential property.

व्यापकता (ता) 1.
f. Diffusion, in-
herence; universality of pre-
sence; gaining. Commonly व्याप्ति.

व्यापादयितव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That
should be put to death.

व्या_पृत (तः-ता-तं)
m. A minister.
a.
Engaged, busy.

व्या_प्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
a. Pervaded; famous;
full; fixed, obtained; surround-
ed; expended.

व्याप्ति-ज्ञान (नं) 1.
n. Knowledge of
an inherent element from its
effects or from induction.

व्याप्ति-लक्षण (णं) 1.
n. Mark of an
inherent element.

व्या_प्य (प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
n. An instrument
or agent; seat of an inherent
element; element or cause as
seen in its effect; a drug.
a.
Permeable.

व्याप्यत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Permeability; ca-
pacity; also same as व्याप्ति.

व्याप्यत्वा-सिद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Incorrect
or defective induction.

व्या_याम (मः) 1.
m. Stretching out
the arms for measuring; a fa-
thom; fatigue, labour; athletic
exercise; manhood; difficulty;
business.

व्या_योग (गः) 1.
m. Dramatic com-
position celebrating athletic
sports, conflicts, &c.

व्या_ल (लः-ला-लं)
m. A snake; beast
of prey; vicious elephant; cheat;
king.
a. Vicious; cruel.

व्यालक (कः) 1.
m. A vicious ele-
phant.

व्यालम्बिन् (म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
a. Hang-
ing on (as clothes).

व्या_वर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. Isolating; choos-
ing; surrounding; revolving;
hernia.

व्या_वहासी (सी) 3.
f. Mutual or re-
ciprocal laughter.

व्या_वृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Isolated; fen-
ced; chosen; excepted; praised;
rolled back; removed.

व्या_वृति (तिः) 2.
f. Isolating; exclu-
sion; screening^1.

व्या_स (सः) 1.
m. A celebrated saint
and author; compiler of the
Vedas, &c.; diffusion; detail; a
measure.
n. A diameter.

व्या_सङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. Confusion, in-
terruption, separation; addition.

व्या_हत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Confused, re-
pulsed; disappointed.

व्या_हार (रः) 1.
m. Voice; articulate
sound; a
bon mot.

व्या_हृति (तिः) 2.
f. Same as व्याहार;
mystical word, as
om.
